Cluster-Robust Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI / PPI++)

Source: R/ppi_clustered.R
ppi_clustered.Rd

Extends Prediction-Powered Inference (gaussian, binomial, and poisson canonical-link GLMs) to clustered research designs (e.g., repeated EMA diary entries within participants, therapy turns within patients, or students nested in classrooms). Automatically handles both disjoint cluster validation (distinct clusters in labeled vs. unlabeled sets) and within-cluster validation (shared clusters containing both labeled and unlabeled observations), computing exact cluster-optimal power-tuning \(\hat{\lambda}^*_{\text{cluster}}\) and cluster-robust sandwich standard errors.

Usage

ppi_clustered(
  formula,
  data,
  pred_col,
  cluster,
  family = stats::gaussian(),
  unlabeled = NULL,
  method = c("ppi++", "ppi"),
  lambda = NULL,
  conf_level = 0.95,
  small_sample_df = TRUE,
  max_iter = 60L,
  tol = 1e-09
)

Arguments

formula

Two-sided regression formula y ~ x1 + x2.

data

A data.frame containing response, covariates, pred_col, and cluster. When unlabeled = NULL, rows with missing response form the unlabeled set.

pred_col

Name of the LLM-coded outcome column.

cluster

Name of the cluster identifier column.

family

Canonical GLM family: gaussian() (default), binomial(), or poisson().

unlabeled

Optional separate data.frame of unlabeled observations.

method

"ppi++" (default, cluster-optimal power-tuning) or "ppi" (lambda = 1).

lambda

Optional numeric override for lambda in [0, 1].

conf_level

Confidence level in (0, 1). Default 0.95.

small_sample_df

Logical; if TRUE (default), uses a \(t\) reference distribution with \(G_{\text{eff}} - 1\) degrees of freedom for small-cluster inference.

max_iter

Maximum Newton-Raphson iterations for non-Gaussian families.

tol

Convergence tolerance.

Value

An S3 object of class c("llm_ppi_clustered", "llm_ppi").

Examples

set.seed(99)
G <- 60
m <- 6
cid <- rep(paste0("c", seq_len(G)), each = m)
u <- rep(rnorm(G, sd = 0.8), each = m)
x <- rnorm(G * m)
y_true <- 1.0 + 1.2 * x + u + rnorm(G * m, sd = 0.7)
y_llm <- 0.5 + 0.85 * y_true + 0.35 * x + rnorm(G * m, sd = 0.4)
is_val <- cid %in% paste0("c", 1:25)
df <- tibble::tibble(
  cluster = cid,
  x = x,
  human_y = ifelse(is_val, y_true, NA_real_),
  llm_y = y_llm
)
fit <- ppi_clustered(human_y ~ x, data = df, pred_col = "llm_y", cluster = "cluster")
fit
#> 
#> ── Prediction-Powered Inference (ppi++_clustered) 
#> Labeled n = 150 | Unlabeled N = 210 | lambda = 0.630 | CI = 95%
#> Clusters (cluster): 25 labeled, 35 unlabeled (60 total; disjoint)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 7
#>   term        estimate std_error conf_low conf_high p_value var_gain
#>   <chr>          <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl> <chr>      <dbl>
#> 1 (Intercept)    0.758    0.117     0.516      1.00 <0.0001     2.52
#> 2 x              1.29     0.0561    1.18       1.41 <0.0001     2.85
